name: Acquired
blurb: Next-level research and storytelling. They dive deep into the strategies and stories behind iconic businesses in a way that’s super engaging and crazy thorough. If you’re into business, this is a must-listen.

name: ACQ2
blurb: Packed with insanely good insights on business and investing. The same Pulitzer-level depth as Acquired, but in an interview format, where Ben and David dig into stories and strategies you don’t hear anywhere else.

name: Dwarkesh Podcast
blurb: A breath of fresh air because you can tell Dwarkesh actually knows his stuff. He digs deep into the material before interviews, so the questions are sharp and the guests actually get to explore new ideas.

name: Founders
blurb: David Senra’s deep dives into the biographies of the greatest entrepreneurs in history. You can tell he’s obsessed with the material, and that passion makes every episode inspiring and totally unique.

name: Invest Like the Best
blurb: Long-form interviews where Patrick O’Shaughnessy brings on the smartest guests and gives them the space to fully explore their ideas. Deep, thoughtful, and packed with insights.

name: Lex Fridman Podcast
blurb: Super popular, and it honestly lives up to the hype. Deep, thoughtful interviews on everything from AI to philosophy. There’s something almost ethereal about the introspective monologues in the black suit against the black background.

name: Modern Wisdom
blurb: Like Joe Rogan, but without the conspiracy theories. Chris Williamson dives into big ideas around self-improvement, culture, and life, grounded in curiosity and thoughtful conversation.

name: Odd Lots
blurb: Random, deep topics that aren’t your typical personal development stuff. They’ve had entire episodes on the chicken industry. Seriously. Joe and Tracy make niche subjects genuinely interesting.

name: The Pragmatic Engineer
blurb: Pure gold if you’re a software engineer: what’s actually happening in the trenches, not generic advice. If you’re not in tech it might not hit the same.
